name: ai-usage-alijany
description: Shows Claude Code and Codex usage limits and a daily budget in the status bar.

aiUsage.intervalSeconds.description: How often to fetch usage while the window is focused. Also fetches when a limit resets and when the window regains focus.

aiUsage.timeZone.markdownDescription: IANA time zone for the times shown, e.g. `Asia/Tehran` or `America/Edmonton`. Empty uses the system time zone. Budget days follow the weekly window, so this changes only how times are displayed.

aiUsage.claude.renewsOn.markdownDescription: Your next Claude renewal date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, from claude.ai → Settings → Billing. Claude does not report it to tools. Later renewals follow automatically using `#aiUsage.claude.billingCycle#`.

aiUsage.claude.billingCycle.description: How your Claude subscription is billed; used to roll the renewal date forward.
